panels.title: CMTC workload security · node ztunnel mTLS, authorization and trust
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**No application sidecars.** CMTC manages intent and trust, SPIRE issues credentials, Cilium owns discovery, capture, policy and xDS, and node ztunnel performs workload TLS and authorization. **Native sections fill only when node ztunnel runs in cmtc-a/cmtc-b; it is OFF in the current combined profile.** Empty native panels then mean *not deployed*, never zero or healthy.

**Quantities stay separate:** TCP attempts, policy rejections, authenticated connections, TLS handshakes and HTTP requests are different things. The pie partitions one stated denominator. Cluster colours are blue cmtc-a and red cmtc-b; outcome colours are fixed. **No panel establishes Protected**: that needs mandatory capture, verified identity, effective policy and real traffic evidence together.

**Start with telemetry coverage and the live issuer profile below.** Expand native diagnostics when ztunnel reports. Planned capabilities remain in collapsed sections until their owning story delivers real scrape evidence; missing data is never a healthy zero.

panels.title: Is node ztunnel deployed and reporting?
ztunnel telemetry coverage · latest by cluster
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Counts only discovered metrics targets and their successful scrapes. Zero means none discovered/reporting, not zero connections, healthy TLS or protection. Rows exist only for clusters with reporting CMTC controllers. Expected node coverage is a separate deployment gate; one UP target cannot qualify the cluster.

targets.expr: (count by(cluster) (up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end())) or on(cluster) (0 * group by(cluster) (cmtc_enforcement_available{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-controller"} @ end()))

(sum by(cluster) (up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end())) or on(cluster) (0 * group by(cluster) (cmtc_enforcement_available{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-controller"} @ end()))

panels.title: Is the public issuer profile current? · opt-in producer
Issuer-profile producer · latest by cluster
panels.description: Optional CMTC public issuer-profile producer in the controller (component cmtc-controller); absent when the opt-in is disabled. It publishes the approved public issuer profile; it does not prove that ztunnel consumed it, that a handshake used it or that traffic is protected. Source read age: seconds since the last successful uncached source read, valid or not; empty before the first read. Lease remaining: seconds until this process's last acknowledged publication lease expires; leases are at most 30 s. An empty lease cell means no acknowledged lease (process start or acknowledged withdrawal). A negative value is an expired lease.

targets.expr: (time() - max by(cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_source_checked_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-controller"} @ end())) and on(cluster) (max by(cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_source_checked_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-controller"} @ end()) > 0)

(max by(cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_acknowledged_valid_until_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-controller"} @ end()) - time()) and on(cluster) (max by(cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_acknowledged_valid_until_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-controller"} @ end()) > 0)

panels.title: Issuer-profile validation attempts/s · by result
panels.description: Optional CMTC public issuer-profile producer in the controller (component cmtc-controller); absent when the opt-in is disabled. It publishes the approved public issuer profile; it does not prove that ztunnel consumed it, that a handshake used it or that traffic is protected. Producer passes per second over $__rate_interval, by closed result accepted/rejected/unavailable. Retries count as attempts, not distinct incidents. Process restart resets the counter.

panels.title: Issuer-profile publication writes/s · by state and result
panels.description: Optional CMTC public issuer-profile producer in the controller (component cmtc-controller); absent when the opt-in is disabled. It publishes the approved public issuer profile; it does not prove that ztunnel consumed it, that a handshake used it or that traffic is protected. Output API Update responses per second over $__rate_interval. An unchanged pass writes nothing, so idle reads zero. A lost response can count error even when the server committed; this is not an exact publication count.

panels.title: Read issuer-profile signals
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content: The chain is organization root → explicitly approved cluster intermediate → exact SPIRE signer → workload SVID. The producer publishes only public material with short leases. **Fresh reads and acknowledged leases show publication, not consumption.** Trust-bundle consumption, SPIRE acknowledgment, issuer verification and rotation are separate planned contracts below. A withdrawal tombstone denies availability; it is not certificate revocation.

panels.title: xDS stream terminations/s · by cluster
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). A steady zero is a stable stream. A burst follows agent restart, reconnect or a rejected update. It does not show ACK freshness or which policy version is applied.

panels.title: Which TCP connections were authenticated, rejected or unverified? · destination-reported
mTLS TCP connections opened · selected range
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Destination-reported only, so each observed connection counts once at the receiving node. Counts cover reporting targets; missing nodes or clusters make coverage incomplete. Read the coverage table and verify expected deployment inventory before treating these as full-cluster totals. TCP opens after peer TLS authentication, labelled mutual_tls; authorization can still reject them. Not HTTP requests or TLS handshakes. Prometheus extrapolates the selected-range increase, so values can be fractional. No series for a cluster means no observation of that kind there.

panels.title: Completed TCP attempts · share by outcome
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Destination-reported only, so each observed connection counts once at the receiving node. Counts cover reporting targets; missing nodes or clusters make coverage incomplete. Read the coverage table and verify expected deployment inventory before treating these as full-cluster totals. Denominator: destination-reported completed TCP attempts in the selected clusters, namespaces and time range, from increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total[$__range]) at range end. The five outcomes are disjoint and exhaust it. No failure flag is not HTTP success. A missing outcome reads zero only while the denominator exists and no selected ztunnel target is DOWN. Zero completed attempts has no meaningful share.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy="mutual_tls",response_flags="-"}[$__range] @ end())) or on() (0 * sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end())))) and on() (count(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) > 0) unless on() (min(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) == 0)

(sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[$__range] @ end())) or on() (0 * sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end())))) and on() (count(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) > 0) unless on() (min(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) == 0)

(sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[$__range] @ end())) or on() (0 * sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end())))) and on() (count(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) > 0) unless on() (min(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) == 0)

(sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="-"}[$__range] @ end())) or on() (0 * sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range] @ end())))) and on() (count(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) > 0) unless on() (min(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"} @ end()) == 0)

panels.title: Completed TCP attempts by cluster and outcome · selected range
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Destination-reported only, so each observed connection counts once at the receiving node. Counts cover reporting targets; missing nodes or clusters make coverage incomplete. Read the coverage table and verify expected deployment inventory before treating these as full-cluster totals. panels.title: Read connection counts and shares
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content: **Opens** count TCP starts; **DENY** counts policy rejections and overlaps opens; the **pie** counts completed attempts. Destination-only reporting avoids counting both ends of one connection. In-flight connections are outside the pie. **mutual_tls** means ztunnel verified a peer certificate chain; the principal is from that certificate, not from a label.

panels.title: Does authenticated traffic flow in both directions between clusters?
mTLS TCP opens/s · destination cluster ← source trust domain
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Destination-reported only, so each observed connection counts once at the receiving node. Counts cover reporting targets; missing nodes or clusters make coverage incomplete. Read the coverage table and verify expected deployment inventory before treating these as full-cluster totals. Authenticated TCP opens per second over $__rate_interval, split by the receiving cluster and the trust domain in the verified source certificate. cmtc-a ← cmtc-b.* is B-to-A traffic; cmtc-b ← cmtc-a.* is A-to-B. Line colour is the source domain; dashed lines are received in cmtc-b. A trust-domain string is verified here only because ztunnel checked the chain; it is not cluster binding by itself.

panels.title: mTLS payload bytes/s · source cluster → destination trust domain
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Source-reported application bytes sent plus received inside authenticated connections, per second over $__rate_interval. Source-only reporting avoids counting both ends. These are payload bytes, not packets or TLS overhead, and not proof that WireGuard or IPsec also protected them.

panels.title: Cluster-pair mTLS connections · selected range
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Destination-reported only, so each observed connection counts once at the receiving node. Counts cover reporting targets; missing nodes or clusters make coverage incomplete. Read the coverage table and verify expected deployment inventory before treating these as full-cluster totals. Selected-range authenticated TCP opens for each receiving cluster and verified source trust domain. Bidirectional acceptance needs both cmtc-a ← cmtc-b.* and cmtc-b ← cmtc-a.* rows from real application traffic, plus the separate negative and packet evidence. Values are extrapolated increases.

panels.title: Which peers and verdicts did ztunnel record? · drilldown
TCP close verdicts and verified peer identities · selected range
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Selected-range closed connections per reporting node, verdict and principal pair; rows with no closes in the range are hidden. Source and destination reporters describe the same connection from both ends, so do not add rows across reporters. Principals of unauthenticated peers show as unknown.

panels.title: Which security violations are observed?
Connections rejected by policy/s · ztunnel DENY
panels.description: Native node-ztunnel telemetry scraped from cmtc-a and cmtc-b (job ztunnel, /stats/prometheus on port 15020). Missing telemetry means ztunnel is not deployed, not scraped or not reporting; it is never zero or healthy. Destination-reported only, so each observed connection counts once at the receiving node. Counts cover reporting targets; missing nodes or clusters make coverage incomplete. Read the coverage table and verify expected deployment inventory before treating these as full-cluster totals. Destination authorization rejections per second over $__rate_interval: the native owner of the original Authorization denials contract. Zero is shown only while the same cluster reports TCP opens; otherwise the panel is empty. A rejection is a working control, not a bypass.

targets.expr: (sum by(cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",response_flags="DENY"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(cluster) (0 * sum by(cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on() (count(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"}) > 0) unless on() (min(up{job="ztunnel",cluster=~"$cluster",component="ztunnel"}) == 0)

panels.title: Read violation signals
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content: **DENY** counts connections that ztunnel authorization rejected at the destination. A rejected plaintext attempt is a working control, **not** a bypass. A plaintext bypass needs an independent verifier that sees unauthorized plaintext reach a destination that requires mTLS; that collector is planned below. Identity and certificate failures are separate from policy rejections.

panels.title: How do real TLS handshakes and remote identity look? · planned
TLS handshakes/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Completed actual TLS handshake observations, labeled by bounded result and one reporting boundary. rate() by result; selected-range increase for totals; not TCP starts or HTTP requests. Owner: Cilium/ztunnel TLS boundary. Expected emitted family: istio_tls_handshakes_total. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_mtls_handshakes_total

panels.title: Active mTLS connections · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Currently active verified workload-mTLS connections, counted at one defined endpoint. Latest value and line if it varies; no rate() or source-plus-destination sum. Owner: Cilium/ztunnel connection lifecycle. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_mtls_active_connections

panels.title: Peer identity validation failures/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Failed peer certificate/identity validation events at the verifier. rate() by bounded reason or selected-range increase; not every plaintext attempt. Owner: Cilium/ztunnel peer verifier. Expected emitted family: istio_tls_handshakes_total {result="peer_verification_failed"}. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_mtls_identity_validation_failures_total

panels.title: Remote identity cache misses/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Lookup misses in the authenticated remote workload identity cache. Misses/s; a miss alone is neither a rejected request nor a security breach. Owner: Cilium remote discovery. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_remote_identity_cache_misses_total

panels.title: TLS handshake p95 · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Actual workload TLS handshake duration in seconds at the TLS boundary. p95/p99 from bucket rates grouped by cluster/le and bounded result; no average or TCP-counter substitute. Owner: Cilium/ztunnel TLS boundary. Expected emitted family: istio_tls_handshake_duration_seconds. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_mtls_handshake_duration_seconds

panels.title: Are trust, issuer and rotation healthy? · planned
Trust bundle consumed · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Required public bundle observed and consumed at the expected generation/digest with freshness. panels.title: SPIRE API acknowledged · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Fresh authenticated SPIRE API readiness acknowledgment at a defined boundary. Mapped state/history; separate API ACK from registration and workload issuance. Owner: CMTC/Cilium SPIRE client. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_spire_ready

panels.title: Issuer chain verified · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Expected issuer can provide a verifiable chain under a defined freshness/issuance check. Metric contract: cmtc_issuer_ready

panels.title: Certificate rotation failures/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Failed certificate rotation attempts or terminal failures with an agreed retry/event boundary. Metric contract: cmtc_certificate_rotation_failures_total
